statement_summary: Qualified Individual and PCI DSS lead designated in writing
Owner holds executive responsibility for PCI DSS and reviews the SAQ before signing
Annual risk assessment with SP 800-30; targeted risk analyses for flexible frequencies
Risk acceptance authority; High risks and PCI not-in-place risks never accepted
Quarterly PCI review signed by the Owner
Scope confirmed every six months and after significant change
Service provider list, agreements, annual AOCs, responsibility matrix
Quarterly ASV and internal scans; annual penetration test; annual independent assessment
Security records kept at least 3 years
Annual policy review; policies available to employees and agents
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Proportionate sanctions; good-faith reporting protected
Named accounts only; no shared logins
Least privilege; merchant impersonation only for support staff; agents view-only
MFA on console, portal, CRM, suite, phone administration, hosting, and MSP logins; number matching
Offboarding checklist completed by the last day or agent contract end
Monthly reconciliation; six-month access review; 90-day inactivity disable
14-character unique passwords in the password manager
15-minute lock and lock when unattended
Named MSP and vendor accounts with MFA; yearly technician list
Call-back to the number on file and second approval for deposit and contact changes
Daily console alert digest and weekly log review
Company systems for company work; need-to-know look-ups only
No card data in email, chat, tickets, paper, or recorded lines; merchant data only via CRM upload; nothing Restricted in AI tools
Approved AI tools only
Lock screens; never share passwords or MFA codes
Training at start and yearly; phishing simulations; call-back drills; tamper course
Report suspected incidents at once
Signed acknowledgment by employees and agents
Payment environment compromise runbook kept and printed
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Owner or Operations Manager reachable 24 hours a day
Log every incident
Notify processor partner and sponsor bank within 24 hours; support Visa's 3-day clock
regulatory_driver: ISO agreement; Visa WTDIC v10.0 A.1

statement_summary: Discovery and determination times recorded; counsel decides FTC, merchant, and state notices
Insurer hotline first; MSP engaged under contract
Preserve evidence; no access to compromised systems except as forensics directs
Ransom or extortion payment only with approvals and an OFAC check
Card data found where it should not be handled as an incident
Annual tabletop exercise with the MSP
Lessons learned within 30 days
Three classification levels
Card data never stored; card security codes never recorded; recording off for card calls
Merchant owner data only in the CRM and portal, via the CRM upload link
Inventory of systems, data stores, laptops, and terminals (scope list)
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit
Approved AI tools only; nothing Restricted in AI tools
Retention schedule; quarterly purge; wiping and shredding
Card data found where not expected: log, delete, fix cause; quarterly search
Payment page script inventory and approval; change log; monthly comparison
Spare terminal inventory and inspection of returned units
New vendors approved and listed before receiving data
Daily suite backup with quarterly restore test
